experiment: A2 audio-only MAE then KL qualification
representation_gate: Best MAE checkpoint must beat the train-mean constant on the same fixed model-selection windows; otherwise report representation-stage failure and skip KL
checkpoint_selection: MAE stage by representation MAE; KL stage and final candidate by free-running dev-clean WER on the model-selection role
sampling: Per utterance/epoch: start window 1/8, end window 1/8, random window 6/8; no excluded burn-in chunks; causal past features only
cost_rule: Require at most half of both same-run complete teacher cost and recorded previous complete teacher cost on dev-clean; report each denominator
scope: One-seed local 100h correction/distillation run. Teacher and small public recognizer have separate upstream training. No FGN/B/C training or adaptive fallback. Qualification is not teacher-WER parity.
